newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM Cargo starts Internet booking trials.
newsitem.headline: KLM Cargo starts Internet booking trials.

text.p: KLM Cargo is starting an on-line freight reservations system via the Internet on a trial basis, a spokesman said.
Named Blue Link Reservations, the trial is due to run for six months.

However, the new service is only for a selected number of clients. Currently, it is not available for the general public. Each client has an identifying number and password to log on to the system, the spokesman noted.
Additionally, he said KLM Cargo is limiting the new service to shipments sent "airport-to-airport" rather than door-to-door.
After the test period, the service will be evaluated and possibly widened for a larger group of customers, said the spokesman.
